circuitpython_naming.rule: Generated CircuitPython must use circuitpython_name exactly as provided in this profile.

allocation_policy.default_pin_policy: Do not recommend a pin unless it appears in pins[], exposed is true, available_for_new_assignment is true, and capabilities match the requested function.
allocation_policy.preserve_tested_assignments: Pins marked proven_isolated or proven_full_system should not be changed unless there is a safety, conflict, or wiring-routing reason.
allocation_policy.shared_bus_rule: I2C SDA/SCL may be shared only by I2C devices. Do not treat an active I2C pin as available for general trigger output.
allocation_policy.voltage_warning: GPIO pins are 3.3V logic. Do not connect 5V signals directly.
allocation_policy.code_rule: Use config.py constants that refer to board.GPIOx objects; avoid direct pin literals in runtime modules.

warnings: GPIO6, GPIO42, and GPIO39 are newly assigned (proposed status). Test each in isolation before promoting to proven_isolated.
GPIO2 and GPIO21 are now freed and available for future assignment.
GPIO8 and GPIO9 are active I2C pins. They may be shared with I2C devices only, not reused as audio trigger outputs.
Direct board.GPIO17/GPIO18 usage exists in code.py and test copies per the project audit; consider routing all runtime pin access through config.py constants only.
GPIO4/GPIO5 appear in the CSV audit as recommended UART TX/RX, but they are already assigned to NeoPixel lighting in the project. This profile preserves GPIO17/GPIO18 for Tsunami UART.
GPIO19 is marked previously failed in the board reference and is unavailable for new assignment until retested.
GPIO0, GPIO35, GPIO43, GPIO44, and GPIO48 are deliberately blocked for normal new assignments because of boot/reserved/USB/onboard-LED concerns.
GPIO39 has SUBSPICSI alternate function. If boot issues arise, fall back to GPIO47 (right-17) for fogger relay.
validation_checks_for_skills: Reject generated code using board.IOx, board.Dx, or raw integer pins.
Reject new pin assignment if available_for_new_assignment is false.
Require capability match: e.g., digital_out for relay/NeoPixel, i2c_sda/i2c_scl for I2C, uart_tx/uart_rx for UART.
Warn before changing any proven_isolated or proven_full_system pin.
Require config.py update plus board_profile.json update for any accepted new assignment.
